decisions.reason: The new three-pin battery connector preserves the existing requirement for an NTC terminal on J_BAT; its connector-family and pinout details belong to the source Requirement and do not change the thermal-monitoring state.
The battery connector selection does not change charge-status display through the SK6812 LED chain or GPIO13.
Changing the battery connector family and pinout does not alter the AXP2101 electrical-protection controller or its cutoff rules.
The battery connector decision does not change the switchable 5V boost rail, its GPIO control, or its powered loads.
The source changes connector family, pitch, pin count, and pin functions but does not change the established battery-connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source concerns the battery JST connector and does not modify USB-C part selection, compatibility, or sourceability.
The battery connector pinout does not change the SK6812 LED family, power interface, or GPIO13 data connection.
The source does not revise the board dimensions, aspect ratio, installation orientation, USB-C edge placement, or mounting-hole configuration.
The battery JST connector decision is unrelated to native USB D+ and D- connectivity.
